title: The §6 witness for §4.5 never configures donations, so it certifies a property that is false in production
description: The witness calls `_fundPots()` only and never calls `nftMinter.setPerMintDonations(...)`, exercising the single configuration (D == 0) in which the §4.5 'fails closed' claim happens to hold. The sibling §4.2 witnesses DO configure donations, so the omission is inconsistent within the same file.
impact: No direct impact. FALSE ASSURANCE: the witness calls _fundPots() only and never calls nftMinter.setPerMintDonations(...), exercising the single configuration (D == 0) in which the §4.5 'fails closed' claim happens to hold. It passes green while CLASS-003 is live. The sibling §4.2 witnesses DO configure donations, so the omission is inconsistent within the same file.
attackPath: Not an attack path — a recall hazard. Same class as this project's recorded 'vacuous invariant harness' failure mode: a test that passes 0 == 0.
justification: QA. No code defect and no value impact — the defect is in the assurance layer. Kept rather than suppressed because it is a false-CERTIFICATION finding, not a vulnerability-in-a-test finding, and because merging it into CLASS-003 would let the coverage regression vanish the moment the code fix lands.
recommendation: Re-arm the witness with a donating dispatcher as part of the CLASS-003 fix.
